tools.name: crt_evaluation_mcp_evaluate_workload
tools.description: Compare CRTG4 and gzip-6 on nonconfidential text/base64 or synthetic fixtures (max 64 KiB). No input storage by this app; public hosting may log requests.

tools.name: crt_evaluation_mcp_verify_reconstruction
tools.description: Reconstruct a fresh CRTG4 stream from public source bytes and compare an independently supplied SHA-256. Does not accept arbitrary encoded streams.

tools.name: crt_evaluation_mcp_calculate_storage_economics
tools.description: Estimate storage-only cost from measured encoded sizes; decimal GB. Does not extrapolate codec speed or paid product benefits.

tools.name: crt_evaluation_mcp_assess_runtime_fit
tools.description: Assess declared fit for the separate paid experimental compiler runtime, not CRTG4. Returns a storefront only for a compatible, explicitly authorized experimental evaluation. No order creation.

tools.name: crt_evaluation_mcp_get_purchase_link
tools.description: Return an attributed public storefront URL only if the fixed live offer reports purchasing available. Never posts to checkout.

tools.name: crt_evaluation_mcp_get_product_status
tools.description: Read the fixed public live product-status endpoint. Never creates an order.

tools.name: crt_evaluation_mcp_get_benchmark_results
tools.description: Get the pinned developer-run CRTG4 benchmark sizes, including losses and controls.

tools.name: crt_evaluation_mcp_get_purchase_requirements
tools.description: Read the separate experimental runtime's purchase requirements and limits. No checkout initiation.

tools.name: crt_evaluation_mcp_get_usage_summary
tools.description: Read anonymous process-lifetime event counters without incrementing them. Caller purpose is self-declared, not verified identity.
